files.README.md:
# Harborlane Analytics - billing export

invoices.csv lists the amounts Harborlane Analytics billed us, one row
per invoice. credit-notes.csv lists service credits Harborlane issued
against those invoices. Each credit amount is recorded as a positive
figure and reduces the balance due on the invoice it references.
